title: Switch Service State
description: Routes its input into the first of several sub-pipelines whose condition holds: the structured if/else of a board. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/switch)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

cases.description: The cases, tried in order. when is an expression over params; pipeline is a list of pipeline entries (see [Browser Sub-Service](./browser-sub-service.md#pipeline-entry-shape)).

ignoreInnerResult.description: Answer with the original input instead of the case pipeline's result: the case runs for its effects.
